blocks.text: In December 2025, Paul Thomas Anderson collaborated with fellow filmmaker Benny Safdie on a multi-perspective and multi-format recording of Winter’s solo performance. The warm hues capture the feeling in the room, including audience reactions, to create an immersive cinematic experience for those of us who couldn’t be there. It’s a rapturous celebration of live performance, whose appeal should reach far beyond the band and Winter’s existing fan base.
Tickets start from £10 for all screenings and events in London, with concessions available for many screenings. Booking information and ticket prices .

If you’re aged 16 to 25, sign up for free to BFI 25 and Under for a chance to get £6 tickets (without booking fees) to all screenings and events, subject to availability.
